correctness.rationale: Exact lumping yields transient Q=[[-2,2],[2(m-1)/d,-2m/d]] with killing 2/d in D. The backward equations solve to both claimed transforms, derivatives give four moments. value.rationale: First-contact distributions govern bimolecular encounters and reaction initiation on network substrates. For all balanced multipartite networks an exact, natural two-parameter classification separates topology-insensitive mean contact times from topology-dependent variances and identifies opposite age dependence of collision hazards under the two geometrically natural initial types. The full distribution and strict hazard inequalities have interpretation beyond a numeric table; no general reaction or mixing theorem is asserted.
